context: Hina-young helps a Yumiko move boxes in the closet; small chore.
purpose: Teen helping grandmother with seasonal cleanup.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: おばあちゃん、このビン、ようけある!
lines.en: Grandma, there are so many bottles!
lines.style: Bright, wonder-struck discovery. Quick intake of breath on the opening. Genuine amazement without performance — the voice of an eight-year-old who's stumbled onto treasure. Rises slightly at the end.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: あんなに、集めたわよ、長年。
lines.en: I collected so many over the years.
lines.style: Warm nostalgia with quiet pride. Soft, unhurried pace. A gentle smile underneath the words — not boasting, just remembering. Settling into the memory as she speaks.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Pure delight, uninhibited. Quick bright attack on the opening. Pitch rises with genuine excitement. No self-consciousness — just an eight-year-old's unfiltered joy at discovering something beautiful.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 欠かしてない箱、移して片付けようね。
lines.en: Let's move the complete boxes over and tidy up, okay?
lines.style: Gentle, practical warmth. Steady, grounded pace. Not commanding — inviting her granddaughter into the work as a shared moment. Slight lift at the end, making it a soft proposal rather than an instruction.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: I found some old business cards!
lines.style: Bright curiosity with a touch of eagerness to share. Quick, engaged delivery. Voice opens up slightly — she's found something interesting and wants Grandma's reaction. Not performative, just genuinely caught by the discovery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 懐かしい、焼いて、記念に残そう。
lines.en: Those are precious — let's photograph them, keep the memory.
lines.style: Tender and deliberate. Slower pace on the opening word. Voice carries the weight of time passing. Reflective but not sad — honoring the past with quiet care. Soft fadeout at the end, like tucking a memory away carefully.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Once we're done, let's have some tea!
lines.style: Bright and forward-looking, a natural reward for the work ahead. Quick, light attack. Genuine warmth and anticipation — she's looking ahead to the next good thing. Slight lift at the end, inviting rather than commanding.
